answer: Agents pricing marble deliveries to an orchard beside a canyon discover offers through a peer network. To resist sybil eclipse attacks, each agent groups reachable peers by independently checked network origin ASN, samples groups uniformly, then selects one peer per group. A thousand aliases in one hosting network gain only that network's share of connections, not a thousand tickets. This requires reliable routing data and several honest networks; attackers renting hosts across many ASNs can weaken the defense.
